process.heading: From first contact to the right result
process.subheading: Here is exactly what happens when you reach out to us.

steps.title: Contact Us
steps.description: Reach out through our contact form, phone or WhatsApp — whichever is easiest for you.

steps.title: We Talk It Through
steps.description: One of our team calls you for a free, no-obligation conversation to understand exactly what you need.

steps.title: You Fill In the Form
steps.description: We send over a short requirement form so we have all the details in writing, ready to act on.

steps.title: We Investigate Your Requirement
steps.description: Our team researches and works through everything needed to match your requirement — properties, experts, paperwork, whatever it takes.

steps.title: We Deliver the Result
steps.description: You receive the matched options and clear next steps, with our team on hand to support you the whole way through.

story.heading: Every home starts with a story like this

chapters.body: “Where do I even begin?” You had questions about buying, selling or moving - and nobody you trusted to ask.
One message. That's all it took. Suddenly you weren't trying to figure it all out on your own anymore.
A real conversation about your situation, your worries, your goals - not a sales pitch, just honest, independent advice.
A clear plan. The right expert for your exact need. A way forward you could actually see.
Your story starts the same simple way every one of ours has - with a single message.
